description.zh: 用户自定义标签，多个标签用
description.en: The user-defined tags. Multiple tags are separated by.
The tag value of the dedicated cluster.

description.zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识。
description.en: A string generated by the server that serves as a request identifier for the client.
The Alibaba Cloud UID of the baseline owner.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~2680071~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~2680071~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 发送报告到邮箱和站内信
description.en: Specifies whether to send reports to email and internal messages.

description.zh:
App使用报告发送间隔，可选：
- Weekly
- Biweekly
- Monthly。
默认Weekly。
description.en:
The send interval of the App usage report. Valid values:
- Weekly
- Biweekly
- Monthly.
Default value: Weekly.

description.zh:
App使用报告订阅状态，可选：
- UnSubscribe
- Subscribe
description.en:
The subscription status of the App usage report. Valid values:
- UnSubscribe
- Subscribe.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs create-app --app-name App1 --app-tags TagKey=controlledBy TagValue=ear --subscribe-status Subscribe --subscribe-period Weekly --description test --report-send-enabled false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --owner 1/0 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs CreateApp --region cn-hangzhou --AppTags.1.TagValue ear --Owner '1/0' --Description test --SubscribeStatus Subscribe --SubscribePeriod Weekly --AppTags.1.TagKey controlledBy --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --ReportSendEnabled false --AppName App1
